_comment: Hand-authored C table for the offline physics-faithful capture model (src-tauri/src/sim_device.rs::e2e_capture). Per-slot base + per-scene C = the sound's max-reachable LUFS at presetLevel=1.0 with outputLevel at its stored value; the model shifts by 20*log10(presetLevel) and a scene-relative outputLevel term. Stored knob values are NOT here — they are derived from scenario-presets.json (never duplicated). C values are chosen so the shipped default targets (-23/-21/-19) solve cleanly on most sounds, and so exactly the intended rows CLAMP (slot 400 scene 2 'Ceiling', slot 402 scene 5 'Quiet', the 401/403 base rows at -19). Keys are 0-based LIST INDICES (device userSlot = index+1). PR2 re-baseline: every C (and the shipped defaults) is +3.0103 LU from its mono-era value. P4-A: the whole table was re-derived for the rebuilt fixtures — see e2e/fixtures/COVERAGE.md for which use-case row each number carries. A slot may also declare `leveledParams` — blocks whose OWN knob drives the capture — each entry `{group, node, param, curve}`, where `curve` is `saturatedPedal` (the default: an ABSOLUTE loudness that REPLACES the flat law; 405's drive pedals) or `wetMix` (a DELTA in LU added to the flat law, zero unless the run sweeps the param; 400's spring-reverb mix).

400._comment: E2E Rig (gtrSeries, two amps + an amp flip, 4 full-overlay scenes; the amp outputLevel is EQUAL on both amps in every sound, so the sim's single-node stored-level probe is unambiguous). Base C=-15 solves below presetLevel 1.0 at every default target. Scene ceilings, with presetLevel 0.32 (-9.90 LU) and the stored amp outputLevel in brackets: Rhythm [0.35] reads -23.90 with +9.12 dB of boost left (every default solves), Lead [0.45] reads -21.90 with +6.94 left, Ceiling [1.00] reads -23.90 with ZERO headroom — the scene-clamp row, and it clamps at EVERY shipped default, which is what makes it the redistribution fixture — and Shared [0.30] reads -25.90 with +10.46 left. WET-FLOOR row (COVERAGE row 18): `leveledParams` declares the SPRING switch's own `ACD_TMSpring63.mix` on the `wetMix` curve — curve rationale is `sim_device::wet_mix_gain_db`'s own Rust doc, not restated here. AT presetLevel 1.0 (the sim's default, until a base solve/save on this slot shifts it): SPRING reads -15 at the authored 0.42, -17.18 at the wet floor (0.25 x 0.42 = 0.105), -12.02 at full wet — so -70 is UNREACHABLE (pins at the floor, `wet_floor: true`) while -16 is reachable at mix ~0.27, 1.18 LU clear of the floor. `presetLevel` shifts both absolute numbers together, so a spec must LEARN a reachable target from a dry run (the `level-rerun.spec.ts` idiom) rather than hard-code -16; the Rust gates hard-code it safely because each runs `save: false` on a fresh SimDevice.

401._comment: E2E Pedalboard (gtrSeries, ZERO scenes — the copy/import + doctor-apply simple-chain fixture). Ceiling -20: solvable at Crunch/Rhythm (-21/-23, quieter) but CLAMPS at Lead (-19, louder than the ceiling) — the re-level-clamped loop.

402._comment: E2E Edge (gtrSplit, 8 scenes, Target 2's baked 2.6 kHz EQ ring preserved verbatim). Base C=-13 solves at every default. Every scene reads its C -9.90 LU (presetLevel 0.32) with the stored amp outputLevel 0.4 (+7.96 dB of boost left), so scenes 0-4/6/7 all solve; scene 5 'Quiet' at C=-48 reads -57.90 — ~35 dB below any default target, so it CLAMPS and is the DOCTOR SNR-badge sound (quiet, NOT silent: `loudest_loudness` errors on true silence, so this is driven by a low C, never a zeroed knob). `offbranchSwitchNode` is the OUT-2 lane block (`ACD_KingOfTone` in G3): this preset routes OUT 2 away from USB 1/2 (`outputMixerSettings.USB12Input.out2 = false`), so engaging that switch under its own isolated measurement captures dead air — the leveller's off-branch routing clamp ("no signal on USB 1/2").

403._comment: E2E Parallel (gtrParallel1, BOTH lane amps active → the joint-k / rebalance / bleed fixture). Neither amp lives in G1, so the sim's stored-outputLevel probe finds none and falls back to 1.0 — which is EXACTLY what both amps are authored at, in base and in every scene, so written/stored is faithful and the joint-k write is deterministic (one k, two identical values). Base C=-20 solves at -23/-21 and CLAMPS at -19. The scene ceilings are loud (-9…-6 → -18.90…-15.90 after the presetLevel term) so every default target is reached by LOWERING the amps — the only direction available at outputLevel 1.0. Scene 2 'Clean' is the exception and the point: it is saved with BOTH lane amps' output at ZERO, so its job has no authority over the capture and returns the ROUTING clamp instead of a headroom one (its C below is never reached).

404._comment: E2E Hiwatt 3S — the CORRUPTION-CLASS fixture, kept VERBATIM (a real 1.8.45 unit's 3-scene + 'Base Scene' preset, saved lastLoadedScene=3, 4 block-acting footswitches). Base C=-17 and scene 3 C=-31 are the MEASUREMENT-CONTEXT discriminator: a base run recalled to base solves -23 (presetLevel ~0.5, done), while the pre-fix unrecalled run measures scene 3 (its saved lastLoadedScene) and CLAMPS (-23 is 8 dB above that ceiling). Scenes 0/1/2 are authored ABOVE -23 so the scene-wipe run converges on amp outputLevel; scene 3 is excluded from that job list (its ceiling is the context probe, not a levelable sound).

405._comment: E2E Preset24 — the STALE-LOAD-INCIDENT fixture (notes/leveling.md's 'Saturated-amp response shape', preset 024 'TR+BD2+BMP'): 4 drive pedals (Plumes/BluesDriver/ObsessiveDrive/Rat, ftsw 5-8) feeding a saturated amp, no scenes. P4-A added a CabSimTMS after the amp (the standing cab rule). Plumes-regression amendment: presetLevel 1.0->0.27, the Twin's outputLevel 1.0->0.28 (both now baked into this C), and Rat's authored bypass flips true->false (base-ON, isActive:true to match) with its volume raised to 0.62 — the fixture now carries TWO measurement regimes on the SAME preset, not one. (1) BASE/pedals-off: `doctor_force_bypass(..., None)` forces every on-off block (all four pedals, Rat included) OFF regardless of its authored bypass, so a base capture always falls through to the flat C law — C=-28 folds in the Twin's 0.28 and the amp's own headroom at that setting; at presetLevel 0.27 (PT=20*log10(0.27)~=-11.37 LU) a base capture reads ~=-39.37, well below the -23 default (base leveling now targets a genuine non-boundary solve toward the flat law, not a pedal curve). (2) Rat's OWN isolated footswitch measurement: `footswitch::engaged_bypass_for_switch` is isActive-aware, so Rat's saved bypass:false + isActive:true renders it ENGAGED during its own switch's capture (every sibling pedal still forced off) — that capture puts the SaturatedPedal curve in charge at Rat's authored 0.62, isolating exactly the sound its own leveling row must judge. Each pedal's OWN knob still overrides the flat C law via `leveledParams` (see `saturated_pedal_lufs`): silent <=0.10, a ~42 LU cliff 0.10->0.20, a compressed plateau above 0.3, all shifted by the new PT.

406._comment: E2E Combined Level (gtrParallel1, parallel Deluxe Reverb + Marshall Plexi, both lanes live). Base C=-16 solves at every default. scenes[0] 'SCRATCH' is the unjudged filler (kept at the base C); scenes[1] 'BASE SCENE' and scenes[2] 'LEAD' are the judged rows and are authored a few LU apart (-14/-11) so per-scene leveling math has real signal to solve against.

407._comment: E2E Doctor Oracle (gtrSeries, amp+cab + 5 bypassed defect blocks + 14 defect footswitches). Base C=-14 solves at every default. scenes[0] 'SCRATCH' is the unjudged filler (kept at the base C); scenes[1] 'SCENE JUMP' is authored well below base (-30, a 16 LU drop) so the scene-consistency loudness-jump check has a real jump to detect.

409._comment: E2E Hiwatt Min (gtrSeries, single amp+cab, the minimal scene/overlay-conformance repro). Base C=-18 solves at every default. scenes[0] 'RHYTHM' and scenes[1] 'Base Scene' are authored mildly apart (-17/-19).

410._comment: E2E Friedman 3S (gtrSeries, TubeScreamer(base-ON) -> MarshallPlexi -> CabSimTMS, 3 FULL-overlay scenes Rhythm/Lead/'Base Scene', lastLoadedScene=1). Declares NO `leveledParams` — the amp's `outputLevel` drives loudness the ordinary flat-C way (`ol_term`), never a curve, and every scene's own outputLevel overlay is authored at 0.5 (base amp stays 1.0, load-bearing so a base capture is never boosted and the fader is never written outside a scene job). Base C=-18 solves at every default target with headroom to spare. Scene ceilings, each at the authored per-scene outputLevel 0.5 (so `ol_term`=0 until a future job writes a different value): Rhythm C=-17, Lead C=-16, 'Base Scene' C=-19 — chosen a few LU apart so per-scene leveling math has real signal, mirroring 406/409's authoring style. Intended as the catalog-verified stand-in for a Friedman HBE-class 3-scene preset (see COVERAGE.md) — MarshallPlexi is the closest cataloged high-gain British-voiced amp to a Friedman, standing in for the real HBE shape the online lane exercises against actual hardware.
